claim: Consider the preferred-orientation Kagome quantum graph of Baradaran and Exner with positive edge lengths \(b=d-c\) and \(c\) satisfying \(b/c\notin\mathbb Q\). For the high-energy universal spectral-probability constant determined by their asymptotic band criterion (3.13), set \(q_0=\sqrt{3/5}\), \(a(q)=2q-\sqrt{4q^2+3}\), \(b_+(q)=2q+\sqrt{4q^2+3}\), \(g(q)=3/q\), and \(e(q)=-(3+q^2)/(2q)\) for \(q>0\). Define \(h_<(q)=1+\pi^{-1}(\arctan e(q)+\arctan b_+(q)-\arctan a(q)-\arctan g(q))\) and \(h_>(q)=1+\pi^{-1}(\arctan e(q)+\arctan g(q)-\arctan a(q)-\arctan b_+(q))\). Then the universal constant has the exact one-dimensional representation \[P_\mathrm{Kag}=\frac{2}{\pi}\left(\int_0^{q_0}\frac{h_<(q)}{1+q^2}\,dq+\int_{q_0}^{\infty}\frac{h_>(q)}{1+q^2}\,dq\right)=0.639080422792129545\ldots.\] The reduction follows from the tangent half-angle factorization of the source's two-phase criterion: with \(p=\tan(x/2)\) and \(q=\tan(y/2)\), its sign is the sign of \((3-p^2+4pq)(3-pq)(3+q^2+2pq)\); the only positive-root ordering change occurs at \(q=q_0\).
scientific limitations/integrity: The claim starts from the published high-energy criterion (3.13) and proves an exact reduction of its incommensurate torus-area constant. It does not re-derive the full Floquet asymptotics and does not claim an elementary closed form. Search-based originality evidence cannot exclude an equivalent formula under different terminology. Numerical checks support but do not replace the algebraic proof.
title: A one-dimensional formula for the universal Kagome spectral probability
